title: David Bowie · Ashes to Ashes
description: The complete supplied video: ruffled Pierrot on a pink shoreline, memory cards, dark-clad procession and yellow bulldozer, padded room and wooden chair, unpainted portrait, monochrome astronaut and attendants, dark water, blue hoses and the final walk with the older woman. Original music with physical mouth-engine singing.
